# Reading function from variation

::: {.callout-warning}
## Draft
Research in progress. Claim records: `research/10-variants-qtl.yml`
:::

_Scope:_ Transcriptomics as the bridge between a genetic variant and its
functional consequence — the progression from eQTLs to sQTLs to isoform-level
QTLs, and clinical transcriptomics as a diagnostic modality. This is where
isoform resolution stops being descriptive and becomes consequential: a variant
whose effect is invisible in gene-level expression but unambiguous in isoform
usage is a variant that gene-level analysis would have called silent.
